sources.title: alexcong/ComfyUI_QwenVL: ComfyUI QwenVL and Qwen wrapper - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository provides ComfyUI nodes that wrap the latest vision-language and language-only checkpoints from the Qwen family. Both Qwen3 VL and Qwen2.5 VL models are supported for multimodal reasoning, alongside text-only Qwen2.5 models for prompt generation.

sources.snippet: The ComfyUI-QwenVL suite brings Alibaba Cloud’s next-generation vision-language and reasoning models into ComfyUI. Featuring native support for the full Qwen3-VL family (2B to 32B, Instruct & Thinking variants), Qwen3.5-VL, Qwen3.6-VL (MoE), Qwen3.8-VL, and Qwen2.5-VL, alongside text-only Qwen3 prompt enhancers.
